title: Puppet masters in Plato's Cave omitted from teaching

tellings.quote: in her latest book called encounters Diana writes that she refrained from teaching her students one thing about Plato's Cave allegory the existence of the Puppet Masters

plain: A religion scholar named Diana Pasulka wrote that when she taught her students Plato's Cave, the old Greek story of prisoners who take shadows on a wall for the real world, she left out one part: the puppet masters who make the shadows. Michels brings this up from her book Encounters, from 2023, which he says is her latest. It matters because it hints that someone may be shaping what people are allowed to see.
